description: We are team “Princess Aurora”. We are curious, hardworking, ambitious, and determined. We are interested in science and space. We are well-rounded.
summary: 'The traces we leave in space', is our digital presentation that explores the stories of NASA’s space hardware and the scientific discoveries they made possible. Our project introduces important missions and technologies, including the Apollo 11 Lunar Laser Retroreflector, Sojourner, Opportunity, Curiosity, Voyager 1 and Voyager 2. By explaining their purposes, achievements, and current statuses, we show how space equipment continues to contribute to science, even after its missions have ended. Our project addresses the challenge by making the history and impact of space hardware accessible and engaging for school-age students. We believe this project is important because it inspires curiosity about space, raises awareness of scientific progress, and encourages the next generation to explore the universe. Through our project, we want to remind everyone that every machine has a story and every mission leaves a mark.
details: 'The traces we leave in space', is our digital presentation that explores the stories of NASA’s space hardware and the discoveries these machines have made possible. Our project introduces five important examples: Apollo 11 Lunar Laser Retroreflector, Sojourner, Opportunity, Curiosity, Voyager 1, and Voyager 2. Through short explanations and visuals, we present their purposes, achievements, mission histories, and current statuses. Our project makes complex scientific information easier and more enjoyable for school-age students to understand. It highlights how space technology contributes to scientific progress, even after a mission has ended. Our main goal is to inspire young people to become curious about space, science, and future discoveries. We developed our presentation using digital design tools such as Canva and collected information mainly from reliable NASA sources. No coding or additional hardware was required. The creative idea behind our project is to present each piece of space hardware as a time capsule, giving every machine its own story. While developing it, we considered scientific accuracy, reliable sources, age-appropriate language, visual design, and accessibility. By combining science and storytelling, we aim to make space exploration more engaging and accessible to the next generation.
